This is first application filed under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of bail to the applicant/accused,
relating to FIR/Crime No.34/2024 dated (not mentioned) registered at Police Station - Choti Gwaltoli, District Indore (M.P.) for commission of offence punishable under Sections 376(2)(n) and 506 of IPC.

sentences.text: It is submitted that the prosecutrix is major and a married lady.
sentences._hearing_file: Nitin vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 15 March, 2024.json

sentences.text: It is also submitted that in the year 2023, husband of the prosecutrix had filed a divorce petition, HM Case No.726/2023, wherein her husband had taken ground of illicit relationship coupled with other grounds, between prosecutrix and applicant.
